testcase.name: progress never exceeds one and never runs backwards across a file boundary
a session totals only the sizes it actually knows
a batch where everything failed offers nothing for deletion
a review with enough space reports no shortfall rather than a negative one
progress on an empty batch is zero rather than a divide by zero
a review with less free space than required reports the exact shortfall
only Secure Move outcomes are offered for deletion
a file of unknown size contributes no partial progress instead of jumping
